questionEn: What characteristic refers to the concept of “Aggregative states of substances”?
questionUz: “Moddalarning agregativ holatlari” tushunchasi qanday xarakteristikaga tegishli?
explanationEn: Three states of aggregation: gas, liquid, solid.
explanationUz: Agregatning uchta holati: gaz, suyuq, qattiq.
